title: Salesforce Killed The Browser. Every Agent Runs Your CRM Now.
cleaned_content: This video discusses how AI agents could fundamentally change CRM interaction by operating directly on behalf of users, potentially eliminating the traditional browser-based interface. This signifies a shift towards more autonomous, intent-driven workflows within enterprise applications, suggesting developers should prepare for agent-centric integration patterns. The core idea is enabling agents to execute complex CRM tasks end-to-end without direct human GUI interaction.
